items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with correct labels; p20 left, p300 right, with tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Log shows 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate A1 through A12 with the p300, and no other wells touched.
Each aspirate/dispense is preceded by a pick up tip and followed by a drop tip; the last step ends with drop tip (line 48).
100 uL is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed.
The single transfer step is fully done with no extra steps; metadata is accurate and there are no false comments.

judge.summary: The protocol transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1–A12 with the p300, using a fresh tip per well and dropping each tip. All rubric items are satisfied.
